description.value: Jade is one of three modern Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat centre spread across 20 forested acres on Bowen Island. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and features a covered cedar porch, reading nook, and an indoor/outdoor ensuite shower. Reaching the retreat requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay, placing guests in a quiet island setting where mountain biking and hiking are among the local activities.
